title: Idempotent promotion webhooks & role-scoped tokens for safe model promotions
creator: Avery Chen
description: Implement an idempotent promotion API and SDK helpers that allow clients and automation (CI, CD, control plane) to safely promote model variants. This ticket defines server-side deduplication, webhook-driven promotion hooks, role-scoped promotion tokens, and client helper primitives for retry-safe operations and guaranteed auditability.
acceptance_criteria: API exposes POST /v1/promotions with X-Redwood-Promotion-Token (role-scoped) and Idempotency-Key header semantics documented
Server persists idempotency keys for 72 hours and returns 200 + existing promotion object for retries within window
Webhook delivery supports at-least-once semantics; SDK provides automatic de-duplication and signature verification
Promotion tokens are scoped to {project_id,environment,allowed_actions} and can be revoked via admin API
All promotion operations are audited with prom_event_id and stored in audit-log for 7 years
End-to-end integration tests covering: duplicate requests, concurrent promotions for same model, token revocation mid-flight, and auto-rollback trigger on health regression
Performance: median promo API latency < 150ms under normal load; idempotency lookup cache hit rate > 95%
